items.title: Jackie Williams interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995
items.q: Oh well it’s been my pleasure, Monk, and I’m glad that you thought of me.

ctx.x: I sure can. Wonderful. All right, well it’s been really fascinating talking with you.
Oh well it’s been my pleasure, Monk, and I’m glad that you thought of me. I’m very happy, and I hope that I’ve conveyed some kind of message to whoever views this.
Yeah. And I like your positive outlook on the future of jazz too because to be honest with you, not everybody shares it.
